<thought>To calculate DBE for C9H7O4, use the standard formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1. No nitrogen or halogens are present, so DBE = 9 - 7/2 + 1 = 6.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the molecular formula likely contains an error; however, following the calculation yields 6.5, which rounds to 7 as the nearest integer.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
